run.final_summary: Observed initial failures on user1<->web1, user1<->app1, guest1<->web1, and the reverse directions from web1/app1 to user1/guest1, while finance1<->app1 and web1<->external1 were healthy. Read topology, host interfaces/routes, leaf static routes, next-hop groups, and scoped interface config; leaf2 remained the common gateway for the failing DMZ/server-side paths. I applied one narrow change on leaf2 to explicitly enable interface ethernet-1/40.0 and its IPv4 admin state, but post-change validation was unchanged: user1<->web1, user1<->app1, guest1<->web1, and reverse paths still had 100% packet loss, while the previously healthy pairs stayed healthy.
